title: A rail budget changes
hook: Two stated cases: explore the absolute budget behind a percentage overrun.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the absolute budget behind a percentage overrun affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Overrun, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the absolute budget behind a percentage overrun in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
